Slide content request:
Create a realistic premium software launch poster. Large headline: 'Parallel Agents'. Subtitle: 'One Workspace for Every Coding Agent'. Show a confident developer at a modern desk and a large framed desktop application area on the right, intentionally leaving a clean rectangular screen region for a real product screenshot overlay. Use realistic lighting and devices, but keep the information layout clean and Fluent-inspired.

Constraints: English text only; avoid gibberish glyphs; clean spacing; legible heading zones; polished keynote slide quality.
